description: Conservation of the human FAH catalytic and Ca2+-binding residues in the bll6422 model
code:
import numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
# values computed in the preceding superposition run (1HYO chain A -> AF-Q89GC3, 266 CA, RMSD 1.55 A)
rows=[("D126","D84",0.76,"conserved"),("Y128","S86",3.82,"substituted"),("H133","H91",0.93,"conserved"),
      ("R142","K101",2.38,"substituted"),("E199","E140",0.87,"conserved"),("E201","E142",0.55,"conserved"),
      ("D233","D171",1.14,"conserved"),("Q240","G178",2.53,"substituted"),("Y244","E181",3.31,"substituted"),
      ("T350","T264",0.98,"conserved")]
role={"D126":"Ca2+ ligand","Y128":"substrate pocket","H133":"catalytic acid-base","R142":"substrate carboxylate",
      "E199":"Ca2+ ligand / base","E201":"Ca2+ ligand","D233":"Ca2+ ligand","Q240":"substrate pocket",
      "Y244":"substrate pocket","T350":"substrate pocket"}
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(9,4.6))
y=np.arange(len(rows))[::-1]
col=["#2f7d4f" if r[3]=="conserved" else "#c1442e" for r in rows]
ax.barh(y,[r[2] for r in rows],color=col,height=.62)
for yy,r in zip(y,rows):
    ax.text(r[2]+0.08,yy,"%s  (%s)"%(r[1],role[r[0]]),va="center",fontsize=8.5)
ax.set_yticks(y); ax.set_yticklabels(["%s"%r[0] for r in rows],fontsize=9)
ax.set_xlabel("distance from the projected human FAH side-chain tip to the nearest bll6422 side-chain atom (A)")
ax.set_xlim(0,6.2); ax.axvline(1.5,ls="--",color="#888",lw=.8)
ax.set_title("Human fumarylacetoacetate hydrolase (1HYO) superposed on the bll6422 model\n266 equivalent CA, 1.55 A RMSD, 19.5% identity over the structural core",fontsize=10.5)
ax.text(1.6,8.6,"dashed line: 1.5 A, side chains effectively superposed",fontsize=7.5,color="#666")
ax.spines[["top","right"]].set_visible(False)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
